出版者的话
古希腊圣哲亚里士多德曾说：‘任何人都会生气，这没什么难的，但
若要适时适所地以适当方式对适当对象恰如其分地生气，可就难上加难
了。’我们现在讲的情绪管理指的就是要适时适所地对适当对象恰如其分
地表达情绪。
现实生活中，人们越来越多地认识到情绪管理能力的重要性，因为
这方面能力出众的人往往在各个领域都游刃有余；相反，此项能力差的
人，虽然可能很聪明，但做起事来往往很吃力。
情绪管理能力虽部分得益于先天因素，但归根结底还得靠后天的学
习和培养。幼儿时期是情绪管理能力培养的黄金时期，一个人在幼儿时
期所获得的情绪经验和习惯会在大脑中形成永久的神经联结，对其身心
发展影响很长远。
当前，亲子共读情绪管理类图画书这种情绪管理能力培养方式已被
广泛认可。优质的图画书好比幸福的种子，通过父母的声音飞进孩子的
耳朵里，植根在孩子的心底，施以阳光、雨露就能生根、发芽。
这套有趣的动物图画故事书温情脉脉，每一本都是有针对性地就孩
子的某一种情绪话题展开，描绘孩子的心路历程，揭示其走出情绪困扰
并解决问题的过程。每一本书都附有幼教专家精心撰写的导读，可作为
家长亲子共读时的参考。
让我们在这套书的陪伴下，去享受一段美妙的亲子阅读之旅吧

page_text_en:
Publisher's Note
The ancient Greek philosopher Aristotle once said: 'Everyone gets angry, and that's not difficult. But to get angry at the right time, in the right place, in the right way, and with the right person, to the right degree—that's difficult.' What we now call emotional management is precisely about expressing emotions appropriately, at the right time and place, toward the right person, and to the right degree.
In real life, people are increasingly recognizing the importance of emotional management skills, because those who excel in this area often thrive in various fields; conversely, those who lack this skill, although possibly very intelligent, often find things difficult.
While emotional management skills are partly influenced by innate factors, they ultimately depend on learning and cultivation after birth. Early childhood is the golden period for developing emotional management skills. The emotional experiences and habits gained during this period form permanent neural connections in the brain, which have a long-lasting impact on physical and mental development.
Currently, the method of parent-child reading of emotional management picture books is widely recognized as a way to cultivate emotional management skills. High-quality picture books are like seeds of happiness, carried into children's ears by parents' voices, taking root in their hearts, and with sunlight and rain, they can grow and flourish.
This series of fun animal picture storybooks is warm and heartfelt. Each book is specifically designed to address a particular emotional topic for children, depicting their inner journey and revealing how they overcome emotional difficulties and solve problems. Each book includes a carefully written guide by early childhood education experts, which can serve as a reference for parents during parent-child reading.
Let us enjoy a wonderful parent-child reading journey with this series.

page_text_en:
Teacher Says to You
Manage Your Emotions, Get Closer to Your True Self
Actually, not only the clownfish in the picture story, but all adults and children on Earth hope to have some special talent, some uniqueness, and of course, a bit of natural ability!
However, characters in picture stories often dramatically showcase their talents, while children reading the story can use their own experiences to understand the clownfish's journey. In this way, the story and real life intertwine, and the clownfish becomes a representative for every child searching for and discovering their own strength!
Look, Clownfish Babu loves to be late, loves to feel jealous, loves to get angry, and is a bit 'arrogant,' always thinking he's better than everyone else. In reality, though, he 'charges forward... like a rocket, flying far away and crashing into an ancient rock.' Imagining his clumsy appearance while reading the words, I can't help but laugh out loud! He truly resembles the children growing up around us—beautiful, lively, genuine, clumsy, and most touching.
Clownfish Babu really wants to attract everyone's attention. His tiny heart is filled with jealousy, but he doesn't understand this bad emotion or how to deal with it. So, he goes to watch performances by starfish, lobsters, seahorses, and dolphins, thinking none of them are impressive, only he is the best. In fact, all children are like this, especially those who have just left home and stepped into kindergarten or school, eager to be liked and recognized by those around them.

page_text_ocr_zh:
证明自己的力量。但是，他们小小的心灵还没有足够的空间接纳其他小伙伴的光芒，对他们而言，这就形成了一个不大不小的矛盾，可孩子自己又无力解决掉这个矛盾。于是，故事中的小丑鱼就像所有小孩子一样，只能用他自己的“办法”去面对这个矛盾了。

这个矛盾引领他经历了一个又一个冲突，巴布用行动表达了自己的嫉妒、愤怒，甚至黑暗心理。最终，鲨鱼的到来，逼迫小丑鱼在极度恐惧下，经由潜意识指引，发现了自己真正的力量。

小丑鱼巴布的故事告诉小朋友们，也告诉大人们，要好好管理自己的情绪，真实地面对这些情绪，而每一次面对，都将会是一次蜕变，在帮助我们表达自己的过程中，无限接近真实的自己。

这个故事最难能可贵之处在于，通过故事化的情境，让小孩子们借由小丑鱼的经历，引起共鸣，了解、认识、表达自己的情绪，并由此去发现，每一个人都是特别的。

孩子的真诚是奉献给这个世界的珍贵礼物。经由真实和真诚，发现自己、接纳自己，管理自己的情绪，是童年的必经之路。如果再能得到成人的呵护与宽容，我相信，孩子们成年后，会更容易接近幸福。

（保定市青年路幼儿园 张艳荣）
page_text_en:
Prove their own strength. But their tiny hearts don't yet have enough space to accept the brilliance of other companions. For them, this creates a not-so-small contradiction, and yet the children themselves are powerless to resolve it. Thus, the clownfish in the story, like all children, can only face this contradiction with his own 'methods'.

This contradiction leads him through one conflict after another. Babu expresses his jealousy, anger, and even dark psychology through his actions. Finally, the arrival of the shark forces the clownfish, under extreme fear, to discover his true strength guided by his subconscious.

The story of Clownfish Babu tells children and adults alike to manage their emotions well, face these emotions honestly, and each time they face them, it will be a transformation. In helping us express ourselves, we get infinitely closer to our true selves.

The most precious aspect of this story lies in its use of a narrative context, allowing children to relate to the clownfish's experiences, resonate with them, understand, recognize, and express their own emotions, and thereby discover that everyone is special.

A child's sincerity is a precious gift to the world. Through authenticity and sincerity, discovering oneself, accepting oneself, and managing one's emotions is the necessary path of childhood. If children can also receive care and tolerance from adults, I believe they will find happiness more easily in adulthood.

(Baoding Youth Road Kindergarten, Zhang Yanrong)
